description: A unit circle centred one unit from the axis has a tangent endpoint at the horn pole. Its three-point reconstruction can put the major and minor radii on opposite sides of equality by roundoff. The axis leg is tangent to the arc at the pole.

analytic.volume: turn * ((pi - a + sin(a) * cos(a) + 1 + cos(a)) / 2 - sin(a)^3 / 3 - sin(a)^2 / 4)
analytic.area: turn * (pi - a - sin(a) + (1 + cos(a)) * (sin(a) + 0.5) + (1 + cos(a))^2 / 2) + pi - a + sin(a) * cos(a) + 1 + cos(a)

occt_step_refused.why: The analytic STEP reader does not reconstruct the horn pole in this partial turn. The pole read-back is covered by step 7 of revolve-circle-meets-the-axis.
